# Provenance

`variant_policy.hpp` is copied byte for byte from the source of Bokoblin Expansion 0.17.0:

- Repository: `iscoremusic26-maker/Mods-Duskligh`, branch `feature/devf-cp21-public-package`, commit `fe47c8b828939829914d466a425cb1e2c0223cd9`
- Path: `DEVF/CP21_PUBLIC_RELEASE/runtime/DEVF/CP10_4_VARIANT_IDENTITY_HP/expansion/variant_policy.hpp`

It is compiled only by `tests/core_lab.cpp`, to check the spawner's reading of Expansion's identity rule against Expansion's own code. It is never part of the mod. `ci/vendor_check.py` verifies its hash.
